metadata.title: Your SaaS
metadata.keywords: saas template, next.js starter, better auth

hero.title: Your product, ready for customers.
hero.subtitle: Secure accounts, organization billing, pooled credits, private storage, and operations are ready. Add the workflow that makes your SaaS unique.

proof.auth: Verified accounts, secure sessions, organization roles, and MFA-ready admin access.
proof.billing: Stripe subscriptions, idempotent checkout, entitlements, and an expiry-aware credit ledger.
proof.operations: Private storage, durable jobs, readiness probes, rate limits, audit trails, and tested migrations.

landing.footer: Crafted in Next.js 15 with Tailwind CSS and Better Auth.

textToVideo.title: Text to Video
textToVideo.intro: Spend credits to generate a short video from a text prompt. This demo uses a mock provider; swap your engine in src/services/ai/video.ts.
textToVideo.errorDetails: Ensure you are signed in and have enough credits.
textToVideo.notSignedInDesc: Please sign up or log in to create a task.

reservation.subtitle: Pick a service, choose a time, and confirm with a small deposit.
reservation.noServicesDescription: This workspace has not configured any services yet.
reservation.noSlotsDescription: Try another date, or refresh availability.

draftNotice.title: Unreviewed draft — not yet a published policy
